profile_selection: largest training-supported exact MOE profile with >=3 training patent IDs and >=100 metadata-matching external holdout rows; no efficacy outcomes inspected
training_access: existing source_train_ids only; no target adaptation
assessment_access: matching source_validation_ids only, scored after predictions and top20 IDs frozen
deduplication: first immutable ID per natural sequence within each partition
assessment_exclusions: same length Hamming <=2 or exact one-base shift from any eligible source-training sequence
selection: 3-fold GroupKFold over connected target/patent/near-sequence components; lowest mean validation MSE; no final assessment access
reporting: target-level top20 measured mean minus exact random expectation; Pearson, RMSE, MAE, seed-free fixed ranking
provisional_readiness_gate: at least 2 evaluable targets, target-macro top20 lift >0 and positive on >=2 targets; a diagnostic gate, not statistical confirmation
safety: unknown; no toxicity screen or clinical claim
optimizer_access: all methods must execute and pay for identical local transitions
expanded_rl_gate: run only if model readiness passes and initial costed PPO comparison shows improvement over strongest local search on validation-only windows; never use final-window measured labels
